abstract: OBJECTIVES: To reveal the demographic features, prognostic factors, and tumor characteristics of patients with non-epithelial ovarian tumors (NEOTs). METHODS: This cross-sectional study was performed using data from all female patients diagnosed with NEOT (germ cell [GC], sex cord-stromal cells [SCSC], sarcoma, and small cell carcinoma) from 2002 to 2017 at Princess Noorah Oncology Center, National Guard Hospital Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. RESULTS: Forty patients with NEOTs were identified. There were equal percentages of GC (45%) and SCSC (45%) origin tumors, and these were the most common histological types. The remaining tumors were sarcomas. Germ cell tumors were more common in younger patients, while SCSC tumors were more frequent in the older age group. CONCLUSION: The findings for protective and risk factors were inconclusive. Patients with GC tumors had better survival outcomes than those with the other subtypes.
abstract_ja: 目的：非上皮性卵巣腫瘍(NEOT)患者の人口統計学的特徴、予後因子、腫瘍特性を明らかにすること。方法：2002年から2017年にかけて、サウジアラビア・ジェッダの国家警備隊病院プリンセス・ヌーラ腫瘍センターでNEOT(胚細胞[GC]、性索間質細胞[SCSC]、肉腫、小細胞癌)と診断された全女性患者のデータを用いた横断研究を行った。結果：NEOT患者40例が同定された。胚細胞(45%)と性索間質細胞(45%)由来の腫瘍が同率で、最も多い組織型であった。残りの腫瘍は肉腫であった。胚細胞腫瘍は若年患者に多く、性索間質細胞腫瘍は高齢者群で多く認められた。結論：防御因子および危険因子に関する知見は決定的ではない。胚細胞腫瘍の患者は、他の亜型の患者よりも良好な生存転帰を示した。
